title: Chinese embassy accuses Filipino reporters, politicians of twisting facts
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Saturday accused Filipino journalists and politicians of distorting facts and exaggerating tensions with Beijing, as it faced mounting criticism…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Saturday accused Filipino journalists and politicians of distorting facts and exaggerating tensions with Beijing, as it faced mounting criticism over Ambassador Jing Quan’s remarks about China’s ability to use force against the Philippines. “Some Philippine politicians and reporters have very limited comprehension about facts,” the embassy
